label: One reachability formula defines a non-trivial target on Nat and Bool
meaning: The single formula 'the object is reachable from the permitted anchor' defines, on Nat with step-two edges, exactly the even numbers, and on the edgeless Bool graph exactly the anchor false; so VaryingPathDefinability holds with this non-constant target family. 1 on Nat and true on Bool are unreachable, and 2 on Nat is reached. Graph adjacency only: no physical applicability or strict FO separation is asserted.
